text: Busy afternoon, Diego. This is the Florida Strait. Report every ship you see.
Good. Now take a bearing, and again in three minutes.
Bearing zero four five… Now zero four five again. The bearing is steady.
Steady bearing, and the range is closing. What does that mean?
Exactly. She's crossing from starboard, so we give way. I'm altering course to starboard.
say: Exactly. She's crossing from starb'd, so we give way. I'm altering course to starb'd.

text: Another ship on the port quarter. She's overtaking us.
Overtaking. She keeps clear of us. Good report.
And one ship right ahead. Head-on!
Head-on: both ships alter to starboard. Let's check the CPA on the radar… One point five miles. Watch her.
say: Head-on: both ships alter to starb'd. Let's check the CPA on the radar… One point five miles. Watch her.

text: Diego, anything on the port side?
And the bearing? Is it changing?
Cadet, what's that ship behind us?
Bearing zero four five… now zero five five. It's changing.
